request.description:
On this loaded host, full `pnpm test` runs in harness/ failed three different tests across three runs — gateway-provider 'sends every request to the run's gateway route…', node/local-host 'serves the live conversation to a watcher…', node/workspace-checkpoints 'runs the host shell's git at the env's checkout…' — each passed on an immediate re-run, and none of their files is touched by this diff. The failure moves between files per run, the classic CPU-contention shape this repository files as a defect rather than re-running forever. Reproduce deterministically (or under synthetic contention) before changing anything; do not raise timeouts to make it pass.
evidence: harness/test/gateway-provider.test.ts, harness/test/node/local-host.test.ts, harness/test/node/workspace-checkpoints.test.ts — observed failing once each across `pnpm test` runs on this host, passing on re-run
